facts.text: Art 2.2 changes effective upon publication and apply to “all accounts, including accounts purchased before the change”; Art 1.3 every account regardless purchase date.

Art 11.1 gambling includes “nearly all” drawdown and no identifiable risk management; final assessment rests with firm, Art 12.5 payout approved or declined at discretion with reasons. Art 12.8/21 internal review (14 days).

Art 12.6 chargeback/dispute without first filing claim leads to closure of all accounts, forfeiture of all unpaid profits and permanent ban. Procedural sequence sanction; Art 4.5 also cancels all unpaid profits if requested verification documents not provided.
Art 9.4 refusal only specified grounds, category communicated and internal review; Art 9.5 already paid payout reclaimed only for fraud, identity misrepresentation or technical error exploitation.
Art 10.9 eligible payout requests submitted before live selection remain payable even if broker refuses verification.
Art 10.10 loss exceeding live drawdown borne by trader and may offset pending/future payouts across accounts. Art 9.6 suspension during insolvency is not breach.
Art 12.1 soft minimum-duration breach allows profit deductions; Art 12.3 Zero news-window profits removed. No explicit statement losses stay counted in reviewed sections.

Public FAQ gambling policy says company 'honors the payout currently requested'; controlling contract Art 12.5 says it 'may be approved or declined at MILTRADERS’ discretion'. Intercom Oct 2026 gambling article and Refund Art 3 repeat discretion. Concrete FAQ/contract contradiction.
facts.locator: What is considered gambling behavior?; https://miltraders.com/terms/ Art 12.5; https://intercom.help/miltraders/en/articles/14664370-what-is-considered-gambling-behavior

facts.text: Zero main funded programme has 'no consistency rule' (evaluation 50% with 1% tolerance, no breach); Pro 30% delay; Instant 20% delay. Most lenient main programme Zero means no consistency penalty.
facts.locator: Consistency (funded); public FAQ Consistency rule during evaluation / Other Key Rules

facts.text: Art 10.1 selected trader cannot decline live transition; Art 10.3 all sim accounts blocked and no other payouts due beyond eligible already requested; Art 10.9 refunds conditional on broker KYC approval; Art 10.10 excess live drawdown losses borne by trader and can offset future payouts across accounts.

Art 8.4 30 calendar days inactivity closes funded account and forfeits unpaid profit; prior support exception discretionary. Art 19.2 independently confirms changes apply to 'Accounts purchased before the amendment'.

Zero fixed cap $1k/2k/2.5k/3k per 25/50/100/150k, 50% profit above locked MLL, minimum $500; subsequent request requires balance above previous request level. Pro progressive caps, buffer; Instant fresh profit goal each cycle. 90% split.
facts.locator: Zero funded accounts; Pro & Instant; Instant FAQ
